shared_or_similar_visual_information: A filled region next to a function curve
mathematical_meanings: Left image: An unbounded-horizontal-interval region under the function graph, annotated as an infinite area. Right image: A selected bounded region between a function curve and a horizontal level.
Rationales: Both use fill to identify a region whose area is bounded vertically by a function curve and a reference line. Bounded versus unbounded horizontal extent changes the area problem, not the region-selecting role.
